hooks.name: Sync GGYGO README after source save
hooks.description: 当 Source/GGYGO 下的源码文件保存后，提醒在同一任务中同步架构 README。

action.prompt: A file under Source/GGYGO/ was just saved. Follow the workspace skill sync-ggygo-readme: inspect the final change and update Source/GGYGO/README.md in the same task when ownership, file layout, public symbols, data flow, or execution order changed. Do not modify README.md merely because this reminder fired if no documented architecture fact changed.
